simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חָרִישׁ (H2758) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: חָרִישׁ (chârîysh) means ploughing or its season First listed occurrence: 1Sam 8 12.

definitions.full: H2758. charish חָרִישׁ noun masculine ploughing, ploughing-time — absolute ׳ח וְקָצִיר Gen 45:6 (E) ploughing and harvesting ; also (= time of ploughing and harvest ) Exod 34:21 (JE); with suffix as accusative of congnate meaning with verb חֲרִישׁוֺ חָרַשׁ 1Sam 8:12 (see above חָרַשׁ 2 ).
